name: FloodSQL-Bench
description: FloodSQL-Bench evaluates models on generating and executing SQL queries from natural language (text-to-SQL) across a curated set of examples. It measures correctness of predicted SQL both syntactically and by execution results against ground-truth databases to gauge practical query accuracy and robustness.
evaluation_method: execution_accuracy (and exact_match for SQL string comparison)
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among text-to-SQL researchers and practitioners.
